objective: Verify a small interval planner against four atomic code claims before changing it.

claims.statement: mergeWindows merges overlapping and touching windows while preserving all covered minutes.
Every returned availability slot satisfies the requested minimum duration.
Planning and merging preserve caller inputs, and returned records do not alias them.
Malformed windows and invalid day or gap arguments reject without changing caller data.

contractRationale: The planner must normalize half-open day intervals, merge touching busy windows, filter availability by minimum duration, and reject invalid inputs without changing caller-owned data.
